name: dott
author: Maqbool Ahmed
_comment: AUTHORING input. The build (tools/pack-sprites.py) reads this and emits
manifest.json + atlas/*.png, which is what the app actually loads.
Never hand-edit manifest.json -- it is generated and will be overwritten.
'frames' lists UNIQUE source files. 'sequence' indexes into that list, so a
ping-pong loop reuses a frame instead of duplicating it in the atlas.
'motion' adds a transform-driven flourish on top of frame cycling, which is
what gives single-frame states a pulse without needing more art.
